Flow.description: Convert button on Lead. A Lead converts only when the customer buys: the user enters the bill; when the Lead's phone or email matches existing customers, the user picks one of their Accounts or creates a new one; LeadConversionTransactionService then saves the Account, the bill and the conversion - all or nothing.

formulas.description: What the customer pays after the reported redemptions; Salesforce sets the same figure on the bill.
formulas.name: Net_Amount_Preview

formulas.description: A new Account when nothing matches or staff chose to create one.
formulas.name: Create_New_Account

formulas.description: The Account Name shown: the one under the Lead when nothing matches, else the one under Create a new customer.
formulas.name: Account_Name_Value

formulas.description: The Company when a user typed it (B2B); "<Name> Family (<Lead Number>)" when Company is the system's (B2C), also for Leads that still hold the earlier "<Name> - B2C-<number>".
formulas.name: Default_Account_Name
formulas.expression: IF( OR(ISBLANK({!Get_Lead.Company}), REGEX(TRIM({!Get_Lead.Company}), "(?i).* - B2C(-[0-9]+)?|.* Family [(][0-9]+[)]")), TRIM(BLANKVALUE({!Get_Lead.FirstName}, "") & " " & {!Get_Lead.LastName}) & " Family (" & {!Get_Lead.Lead_Number__c} & ")", TRIM({!Get_Lead.Company}) )

formulas.name: Customer_Type_Label
formulas.expression: IF({!Convert.isExistingCustomer}, "Existing customer - bill added to their account", "New customer")

Flow.label: Convert Lead
